==================
Integer literal
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Dim x = 42
    End Sub
End Module

    Sub Main()

        Dim name$ = "test"
        Dim total& = 100
        Dim rate# = 3.14
        Dim price@ = 9.99
    End Sub
End Module
